answer: Yes. The teacher’s “Wotanshut” and “Jupiterbart” allude to mythological gods, lending his authority a humorously grand, almost divine quality. Calling the departing pupils “Scharen der Befreiten” frames school’s end as liberation, while “Siebensachen der Wissenschaft” playfully elevates their rattling school supplies. These expressions enrich the scene with irony and reveal the social hierarchy through the children’s perspective.
